baseline.note: This is an audit of baseline gaps, not a claim about work implemented after the audit. Current main or the initial dirty Python checkout is not the release oracle.

priorities.gap: Rust unconditionally refuses duplicates; Python default redispatches and preserves original completed result, recording conflicts. 1.6.0 added an opt-in guard with default false.
acceptance: Default duplicate model/tool calls dispatch and preserve original result plus result_conflicts.
Opt-in refusal occurs before budget reservation, policy re-evaluation and dispatch.
Explicit attempt changes are accepted.
Guard does not change hybrid/replay hits.
Persistent reopen preserves refusal.

priorities.gap: Rust rejects estimates absent under token budgets and raises UsageError for invalid usage; Python allows such calls and records conservative available estimate or zero token charge. Refusal payload/requested/remaining and metadata need byte-exact release fixtures.
acceptance: First-run root/model identities and result digest match verified wheel.
With an estimate, invalid usage settles estimate and accounting_fallbacks.tokens reason/source metadata.
Without an estimate, invalid usage records step charge only and succeeds.
Actual usage overshoot persists and blocks later calls.
Refusal reason, meter, blocked_kind, blocked_payload_digest, requested/remaining strings, estimated=true match.
Arbitrary Python integer identities remain a documented numeric limitation unless intentionally implemented.

priorities.area: Runtime lifecycle, reports and dry run
priorities.gap: resume, prune, structured report, dry_run and node callbacks missing.
acceptance: Resume deepest non-pruned leaf, lexical ID tiebreak, refuse missing root.
Prune flags cursor; rollback does not refund; branch has independent cursor with shared ancestor budget.
Report spent and avoided maps; replay skips live budgets/dispatch/policies.
Dry-run registered tools produce resultless nodes and strict replay rejects these.
Callback failures warn without invalidating completed runs.

priorities.gap: All Rust callback calls synchronous and non-streaming.
acceptance: Chunks forward in order; keep_chunks stores and replay re-emits them.
Chunk result replaces accumulator; delta merges recursively; strings append; lists concatenate; other values replace.
Settle once after stream end; identity independent of streaming.
Post-first-chunk failure conservatively settles estimates and preserves unknown-outcome marker.
Async model/tool, confirmation, branch/resume/revalidation follow equivalent contracts.

priorities.gap: Rust MemoryStore only; no SQLite or transaction reservation contract.
acceptance: SQLite schema compatible with Python, preserves exact result_text and detached data.
Strict replay physically read-only and does not create missing DB.
Atomic budget/window reservations across independent runtime connections.
Lease renewal, stale leases, uncertain settlement, post-dispatch errors and reconnect are fail-closed.
Schema versions fail closed; migrations explicit.
Seal uses pollard/v1:seal newline domain and deterministic Store.walk ordering.
Seal/export match first-run Python fixture including exact result text.
Import fully validates format, all nodes and seal before writes; missing external parent rejected.
Merge preserves first results, reports conflicts, validates ancestry and reruns idempotently.
GC drops pruned descendants and returns survivor seals; explicit compaction.
SQLiteSealSink independently persists seal custody.

priorities.gap: Rust integer steps/tokens/depth only; Python usd, seconds, extra custom meters, CostMeter, WindowMeter and measurement hooks absent.
acceptance: Decimal-safe USD charge and limits.
Default meters include steps/depth/wall-clock/tokens.
Custom meter precheck/settle hooks, expected auditable refusal and configuration-error separation.
Window limits with stable ledger key, exact transactional reservations.
Tokenmaster 0.2 profile/output/context checks, tier pricing, governance factory; NVML optional local energy.

priorities.gap: ReplayContract, comparison types and live observation flow unported.
acceptance: Contracts bind immutable execution fingerprint into payload.
Exact and normalized comparator differences are bounded value-free JSON pointers.
Explicit record-mode observation spends budget but preserves golden recording.
Failure evidence does not leak raw result values; sync/async behavior match.

priorities.gap: PostgresStore, RedisStore, MongoStore, Neo4jStore, KafkaStore, HashRopeStore missing.
acceptance: Remote shared budgets retain exact Python reservation contract for PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB and Neo4j.
Kafka is ordered replay/audit only; dedicated single partition infinite retention, no shared arbitration.
Reconnect validates exact schema/coordinator/index constraints without implicit repair.
Environment-backed credential-safe store selectors and destination prevalidation before writes.
Hashrope is in-process append-only backend, not multi-writer database.

priorities.gap: Rust has no CLI or provider/framework adapters, MCP bridge, OTel export, prompt estimators or pytest replay plugin.
acceptance: CLI show/report/verify/seal/export/runs and validated merge; SQLite-only import/gc.
OpenAI Responses/Chat, Anthropic, Bedrock and LiteLLM normalization with sync/async/stream coverage.
No implicit credentials, clients or network at import/runtime.
Pydantic schema helper/MCP discovery and registered handlers where Rust equivalents exist.
Content-free OTel export and reproducible recording replay tooling.

performance_acceptance: Use exact verified PyPI wheel outside initial dirty checkout, not local source version.
Record exact wheel hash, Python/Rust versions, crate source/commit, machine/OS, release build, fixture/payload sizes, iterations, warmup and samples.
Compare MemoryStore record, hybrid-hit, strict replay-hit; add SQLite only when equivalent persistence and transactional guarantees exist.
Report median/distribution and raw samples. Check correctness/output charges before timing.
Benchmark both tiny empty/short payloads and growth with many stored nodes; total record/replay costs can become quadratic through accounting/walk/verify.
Separate native-core throughput from provider/network time; report regressions and unsupported features, no blanket full-parity or distributed throughput claims.
Python release EXP-007 registers protocol but explicitly makes no quantitative performance claim. Review evidence/EXP-007 and its runner before presenting release-comparable conclusions.
